Ivy K: FYI saw a sharp preview > final delta for tenant pixelflow at 04:12 UTC (~29%). Preview shows duplicate token lines in a narrow window.
Marco D: Any recent egress or LB activity?
Ivy K: Ops rotated a small host set at 04:10 during autoscale. Logs show a burst of X-Generated-Client headers right after.
Sasha V: That matches previous incidents. Our preview pipeline dedupes early on `session_fingerprint = hash(client_ip, conn_id, api_key)`. When egress or conn_id changes mid-flow, preview can double-emit. Ledger dedupe uses req_id later so final is correct.
Ivy K: Example header from logs:

Sasha V: ```
POST /v1/chat
Authorization: Bearer key_zzz
X-Generated-Client: proxy-conn-1a2b
X-Request-Id: -
```

metering-bot: metric: billing.preview_delta_pct{tenant="pixelflow"} = 29.4
Marco D: Short-term: request ops to pin egress pool for 20m to stop further churn. Also mute preview alert for the tenant while we triage.
ops-bot: action: pin-egress requested for pool=us-east-2a by @Marco D ETA=5m
Ivy K: Mid-term ideas: (1) prefer X-Request-Id for early dedupe when present, (2) compute a lightweight payload_hash fallback only when req_id missing or generated-client present, (3) add a `preview_confidence` flag so console can mark provisional totals.
Sasha V: Perf note: computing payload_hash for all requests at 100k QPS is expensive. We'll gate it behind a flag and only compute when headers indicate instability.
Marco D: UX: console should show a small badge next to invoice preview totals: "Preview confidence: LOW" with hover text "Low confidence due to recent edge routing changes; see runbook" and a link to the runbook. That should reduce support tickets.
Ivy K: Telemetry: add counters for events using generated-client fallback, payload_hash_used, and preview_rows_provisional. Also expose a histogram for preview_confidence. We'll use that to size canary.
Sasha V: Deployment plan: implement dedupe-v2 (prefer req_id -> payload_hash fallback), feature-flag it, shadow mode in prod for 1h, then enable for 5% tenants. Mute preview alerts for canary tenants during shadow.
Marco D: I'll open INC-6101 for customer outreach and PR-7012 for dedupe-v2. Also DASH-321 for console badge & alert tweak.
Ivy K: Add runbook note: "If preview > final: check recent egress or sticky-ttl changes; look for X-Generated-Client spike; pin egress or rollback rotations; consider manual invoice adjustment if delta persists > 30% for >15m." Keep it short.
Sasha V: I'll add telemetry and a small pseudocode snippet to PR to show gated payload_hash compute.
Marco D: One more: add an automated console annotation when we detect preview_confidence=LOW for a tenant, visible to support and in the tenant's billing page.
Ivy K: Agreed. That should cut noise. I'll follow up on INC-6101 and send a note to CS. Thanks team.
